explanation: Requested kinematics (eta electroproduction, ep -> e'p eta, at W = 1.45 GeV, Q2 = 0.4 GeV^2, cos(theta*) = 0.1, phi* = 30 deg) are below the physical threshold for this reaction. The threshold is W_thr = m_p + m_eta = 0.938272 + 0.547862 = 1.486134 GeV; at W = 1.45 GeV there is not enough invariant mass to put a proton and an eta meson on-shell, so the Born cross section is exactly zero and no radiative correction is defined. Being 'above the Delta(1232)' is not the relevant criterion here -- the Delta is a pi-N resonance in the pion-production channel and has no bearing on the eta production threshold. This is confirmed by the eta/mpintp.inc EtaMAID-2023 table, which only tabulates W from 1.4856 GeV upward, i.e. it does not cover W = 1.45 GeV either. No input file was generated. To proceed, choose W >= ~1.487 GeV (the lowest physically populated point on the EtaMAID grid), or clarify if a different reaction/threshold was intended.
